title: Accounts Assistant

description:

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Full job description

We are seeking a highly organised and proactive Accounts Assistant & Credit Controller to join our

growing property management and lettings team.

This role is responsible for the day-to-day management of credit control activities, allocation of rent

payments, processing supplier and contractor invoices, and supporting the efficient operation of the

client accounts function. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining healthy cash flow,

reducing arrears, and delivering excellent service to tenants, landlords, contractors, and internal

stakeholders.

Working in a fast-paced and professional environment, the successful candidate must be detail-

oriented, confident communicating with clients, and capable of managing multiple priorities while

maintaining a high level of accuracy and professionalism.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Credit Control
- Conduct daily credit control activities across the property portfolio.
- Proactively pursue outstanding arrears and overdue balances through telephone calls, emails,

and written correspondence.
- Liaise with tenants, landlords, and portfolio managers to resolve payment issues and account queries.
- Monitor arrears and ensure all cases are actioned in accordance with company policies and

Rent Allocation & Client Accounts Support
- Accurately allocate rent payments to tenant ledgers.
- Investigate and resolve payment discrepancies in a timely manner.
- Ensure tenant and landlord account records remain accurate and up to date.
- Support the wider property and accounts team with account reconciliations and financial administration.

title: Accounts Receivable Administrator
company: Four Squared Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Contract
description:
Accounts Receivable Administrator
Birmingham Hybrid (2-3 days office)
9-Month Fixed-Term Contract Up to £30 K
Are you an organised finance professional with strong customer service skills and a keen eye for detail?
We're recruiting for an Accounts Receivable Administrator to join a busy and supportive finance team on a 9-month contract basis. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in accounts receivable, credit control or finance administration who enjoys building relationships, resolving queries and ensuring financial records are maintained accurately.
Working as part of a collaborative finance function, you'll play a key role in managing outstanding balances, supporting income collection processes and helping to maintain the accuracy of customer accounts.
Key Responsibilities
- Managing customer accounts and proactively following up on outstanding payments
- Building strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve payment and invoicing queries
- Raising and processing invoices accurately and in a timely manner
- Maintaining aged debtor reports and supporting debt recovery activities
- Completing daily and monthly bank and account reconciliations
- Allocating cash receipts and investigating discrepancies
- Conducting credit checks and supporting customer account set-up processes
- Maintaining accurate records, audit trails and financial data within finance systems
- Assisting with month-end activities, reporting and cashflow-related administration
- Supporting continuous improvement initiatives and finance process enhancements

About You
- Previous experience within Accounts Receivable, Credit Control or a similar finance administration role
- Confident communicating with customers and stakeholders via telephone and email
- Experience managing customer accounts, reconciliations and payment allocation
- Strong understanding of credit control principles and debtor management
- Excellent attention to detail and high levels of accuracy
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, filtering and data analysis
- Proactive, resilient and solutions-focused approach
- Able to work independently whilst contributing positively to a wider finance team

What's on Offer?
- Salary up to £30,000
- Hybrid working (2-3 days in the office)
- Immediate opportunity to join a well-established organisation
- Varied and interesting role with exposure to a broad range of accounts receivable responsibilities
- Supportive team environment with the opportunity to make a genuine impact

If you're looking for a role where you can utilise your accounts receivable and credit control experience while working within a collaborative finance team, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Credit Controller
description:
SF Recruitment is recruiting for a Credit Controller to join a finance team in a hybrid working opportunity.
This role would suit someone with previous credit control experience and a working knowledge of SAP, who enjoys taking ownership of a ledger and building strong customer relationships.

You'll play a key part in keeping cash coming into the business, resolving queries and ensuring overdue balances are followed through to resolution.

Your responsibilities will include:
Managing your own ledger, chasing outstanding payments by telephone and email.
Investigating invoice queries and working with internal teams to resolve payment delays.
Reconciling customer accounts and maintaining accurate records on SAP.
Agreeing payment dates, monitoring commitments and escalating overdue accounts where required.
Producing aged debt updates and highlighting potential collection risks.

What we're looking for:
Previous experience in credit control, including using SAP.
A confident communicator who can build relationships while having firm conversations about payment.
An organised, proactive approach to managing a busy ledger.
Good Excel skills and attention to detail.

If you're looking for a credit control opportunity offering hybrid working and ownership of your accounts, please apply with an up-to-date CV.
